title: 御定子史精華·卷二十~卷二十三 (vol 7)
shelf_note: Siku quanshu manuscript copy of the Qing imperial leishu Yuding Zishi jinghua (juan 22 on these leaves); a general-library item, consistent with the 'universallibrary' collection.
structure_note: 192 page records, 162 with OCR, 140 translated: the volume is only partly readable in English. Only 20 pages carry a printed number, with 7 backsteps and 11 repeats; on my run the leaf number sits in the split centre column (十九 on p138, 二十 on p139) and each leaf number is shared by two half-leaf images, so repeats are expected and I read the backsteps as misread or half-visible leaf numerals, not a scan disorder. Text runs continuously across 137-138-139.

title: Dreams
shelf_note: A Societas Rosicruciana in Anglia pamphlet by W. Wynn Westcott from the BPH; squarely within the library's Rosicrucian/occult-revival scope. No tradition or collection is set on the record.
structure_note: Catalogue identity is wrong: the record says original_language 'Latin', but the pamphlet is in English throughout (only the society's name and titles are Latin), and that is what sends an English text through translation. pages_translated field says 10 while 12 page records carry a translation. The cover's printed '[COPYRIGHT.' is a period notice on an undated pre-1925 pamphlet, not a modern rights mark.

title: Cosmographey : oder Beschreibung aller Länder …

structure_note: 1,558 page records but only 25 with OCR and 23 translated: a visible book whose reader text stops after the preliminaries. No printed page numbers recorded (these leaves carry signatures a ij, a iij only). The three pages run in order (catchwords 'vnd' and 'Sie' match).

title: Le Nuove Musiche
shelf_note: Caccini's Le nuove musiche (Florence, Marescotti, dated 1601), BNCF copy; early modern music, in scope for the BNCF collection.
structure_note: Every image in the run is an unsplit two-page opening (18|19, 20|21, 22|23), so the 33 records are openings, not pages. The one printed backstep and one repeat are most likely misread page numerals, as on p22 where the OCR gives '29, 31' for an opening that sits between 18|19 and 22|23. Staff notation is described, not transcribed (25 of 33 records have OCR, 23 a translation).

title: Incomplete manuscripts
shelf_note: A bundle of unrelated Tibetan fragments from the Ogyen Choling collection (BL): Buddhist tantric ritual, at the edge of the library's scope, with no tradition or collection set. Title is a cataloguer's bucket and 'author' is the name of the collection, so the record does not say what a reader is opening.
structure_note: Not one work: a set of fragments, each photograph showing two pecha leaves (or the two sides of one) on a board with tapes, pins and the archivist's sticky note, so printed backsteps (2) and repeats (5) are expected. p56 is a board with only a sticky note. Counters disagree: 135 page records have OCR but the pages_ocr field says 59; 55 of 157 are translated.

ocr_errors.problem: the only words on the image misread: 'mjug chad' (the end is missing) became 'mdzub chad' (finger cut off). It pairs with the note 'dbu shog chad' on the next two photographs

tr_errors.english: 'Missing finger/index' <note>original: "mdzub chad"</note>
tr_errors.problem: should be 'end missing'; the translator's guess that it marks a missing portion is right, the rendering is not

other.note: a separator photograph (archivist's sticky note on the imaging board, no manuscript) is served as a page of the book, with a nested <note> inside a <note>

tr_errors.problem: both measures wrong: the mandala is one arrow-length (mda' gang) and the circle one cubit (khru gang)

tr_errors.problem: bskyed bstim is generation and dissolution

tr_errors.english: First, regarding the practice: apply it to the activity.
tr_errors.problem: the end of a list (approach, accomplishment, application to the activities) made into an instruction, with 'First' added

other.note: two leaves in one photograph, joined in the text with <leaf-break/>; <term> used for glosses rather than terms ('siddhi <term>spiritual attainment</term>')

ocr_errors.problem: abbreviated words rendered as impossible stacks; same limits on my reading as p57, line counts (6 + 6) match

tr_errors.english: remain in a state of self-contained bliss
tr_errors.problem: 'sit on a comfortable seat'; the same phrase is rendered 'sitting comfortably' lower on the page

tr_errors.english: white and sweet offerings
tr_errors.problem: 'the three whites and three sweets' loses its number

tr_errors.english: Place four containers, each filled with a bit of blood, among the other fourteen.
tr_errors.problem: fluent sentence built on a garbled line; 'fourteen' is the translator's arithmetic on 'seven, two'

other.note: the archivist's sticky note is the first line of the reader text, as plain prose: 'The first page is missing.' (on p57 the same note is a <meta>)

book_verdict: A catalogue bucket of fragments rather than a book: photographs of leaf pairs and separator cards, a BDRC read of cursive script full of impossible stacks, and a fluent translation over it that gets ritual measures wrong. I read dbu med poorly at this size, so the page scores are low-confidence; the unit and structure problems are not.
